title: 用 Claude Opus 5.5、Blender、Unreal Engine 和 Meshy 构建游戏的七步教程
summary: 一篇教程介绍用 Claude Opus 5.5 配合 Claude Code、Blender、Unreal Engine 5 和 Meshy 构建游戏的方法。核心思路是给每个工具分配单一职责：通过 MCP 连接 Blender 和 Meshy，由 Meshy 生成道具和角色、Blender 清理和放置、Unreal 负责光照物理和游戏本身、Opus 在一个对话里调度三者。流程为先让 Opus 头脑风暴 5 个游戏点子再展开，告知 GPU 以便压满画面性能，首个完整构建约花 4 小时和约 19% 的每周 Max plan 用量，之后因素材复用会快很多。

title: HireKey

Unlike basic ATS tools, HireKey combines AI with 10 years of recruiting experience at Microsoft, Amazon & Stripe, plus practice out loud with an interactive AI voice coach that responds to your answers & provides real-time interview feedback.

title: Automations in Perplexity Computer
summary: Automations that remember, act, and keep work moving
body: Computer Automations turns recurring work into reliable, ongoing workflows. Define a task once... such as monitoring sources, compiling reports, updating trackers, or drafting follow-ups... and an agent executes it on a schedule or in response to triggers. Built for professionals, teams, and operations leaders who need continuity without constant supervision, it remembers prior runs, builds on accumulated context, and acts proactively rather than waiting for a prompt.

title: MePersona
summary: Answer every fan comment in your voice
body: MePersona is the unified social media inbox for content creators, but the inbox is only where it starts. Your Persona learns how you talk and improves with every reply you approve. It drafts replies to comments and DMs from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and more, scores how much each sounds like you, and remembers what each fan said last time. Nothing posts until you hit Send. It works in English and Spanish, so bilingual creators stop choosing which half of their audience gets a real answer.

title: Ayven
summary: Carries and drives your team's agenda
body: Ayven drives your agenda. It means observing, cutting the work into pieces your team can take one at a time, putting an owner and a date on each, and filing them in Jira or YouTrack. Then it runs, tracks and talks about the work for weeks: asking whoever knows, waiting, chasing silence, moving work when someone is away. Your team answers in Slack and the board moves. Planning stops being the barrier and you ship your agenda like crazy.

title: Foley
summary: A voice to-do list that files, plans and asks first
body: Say what needs doing. Foley turns it into a task with the project, date and reminder already set, and asks when it isn't sure instead of guessing. When plans change, say so and it moves the task. Ask it to plan your day, or what to work on first, and it answers from your list. Capture from your Apple Watch. The desktop app is free with no account, using your own OpenRouter key. Foley Pro runs the AI for you and syncs every device. On iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and the web.
